_comment: Branch protection for the default branch, kept as a file so it is reviewable
and reproducible instead of clicked once into a settings page and forgotten.
Apply it with scripts/apply-ruleset.sh; that script PUTs this document over
the existing ruleset of the same name, so this file is the source of truth.
APPLY THIS AFTER the workflows have run at least once. The three required
contexts below only exist once GitHub has seen them, and a ruleset that
requires a check which never reports blocks every pull request forever.
The `_comment` keys are stripped, recursively, before this is sent — they
are notes for whoever reads the file, not part of the API schema.
name: main

_comment: The sole maintainer, exempted because GitHub does not let anyone approve
their own pull request: with one required approval and one maintainer,
an unexempted owner cannot merge their own work at all.
This entry is the temporary half of the arrangement. When a second
maintainer joins, delete it — the rule underneath already says what it
should say, and removing the bypass is what turns it on.
